Linus and Luke discuss Overwatch 2 being rebranded back to just Overwatch after promised PvE content and hero missions never arrived. They reflect on Blizzard’s current state, noting that franchises like WoW, Hearthstone, and Diablo are mostly in maintenance mode and catering to long-term fans. They also highlight how mobile gaming audiences, like Diablo Immortal players, are completely separate from traditional Blizzard fans.
